quantum_model.feature_map: H + RZ(x_i) per wire, then CNOT-RZ(x_i*x_j/pi)-CNOT on neighbouring wires, repeated

score_definition: percentile of the raw one-class score within the synthetic reference population; bands NORMAL < 0.80 <= UNUSUAL < 0.95 <= HIGH_ANOMALY (screening heuristic, not a fraud threshold)
